business_summary: New Provenance Everlasting Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, sources and sells metal minerals and related industrial materials in the People's Republic of China. It is also involved in the production and sale of utilities and industrial products; investment in clean energy business; and provision of logistics services, including warehousing, transportation, and cargo handling, as well as management services. The company was formerly known as BEP International Holdings Limited and changed its name to New Provenance Everlasting Holdings Limited in October 2017. New Provenance Everlasting Holdings Limited was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 New Provenance Everlasting Holdings Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 금속 광물 및 관련 산업 자재를 조달 및 판매합니다. 또한 유틸리티 및 산업 제품의 생산 및 판매에도 참여합니다. 청정에너지 사업에 대한 투자; 창고, 운송, 화물 취급을 포함한 물류 서비스 및 관리 서비스 제공. 이 회사는 이전에 BEP International Holdings Limited로 알려졌으며 2017년 10월에 New Provenance Everlasting Holdings Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. New Provenance Everlasting Holdings Limited는 1984년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
